text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali received a message from French President Jacques Chirac on Thursday. The message was handed by French National Assembly Speaker Philippe Seguin.
- Ben Ali's visit to France will not coincide with the campaign period for next month's French elections.
- Tunisia, Ivory Cost started trade talks in Tunis on Thursday.
- Tunisia looks at exporting olive oil to the United States.
- The International Handicrafts Organisation to hold its congress in Tunisia on May 12-14.
- Environment Minister Mohamed Mehdi Mlika says the government is setting up a programme to protect the country's water ressources.
- Seguin says Ben Ali's next visit to France must be fully successful.
- Tunisian Parliamentary Speaker Habib Boulares met the French Senate Speaker Rene Monory in Paris on Wednesday.
